name: type
label: Type
help: Lead for a people search, Account for a company search. It must match the Search URL.

name: customSearchUrl
label: Search URL
help: The search URL copied from your browser's address bar in Sales Navigator: a /sales/search/people URL for a lead search or a /sales/search/company URL for an account search.

name: name
label: Name
help: Optional name, up to 256 characters on one line. Leave empty to keep the name Sales Navigator gives the search. If another saved search of this type already has this name, the module fails.
